findings.current: Hearing about the beginning and end of the being called the Martial God had finally made me certain of the identity of another person like him—one who had existed beneath a different sky.
findings.defect: “Another person like him” presents the modern-world figure as distinct from the Martial God, while chapters 1142–1144 develop the possibility that they are the same person.
findings.rationale: Preserves Taekyung’s emerging theory without resolving the identity question early or contradicting the following chapters.
findings.replacement: Hearing about the Martial God’s beginnings and end had finally strengthened my suspicion about who he was beneath a different sky.

findings.current: After a week of watching the second hand stay exactly where it was, I shoved this sturdy piece of trash deep into my Inventory.
findings.defect: Chapter 1144 says the watch has only one hand and identifies it as an hour hand.
findings.rationale: Removes a contradictory second hand while retaining the observation that the watch appeared broken.
findings.replacement: After a week of watching its sole hand stay exactly where it was, I shoved this sturdy piece of trash deep into my Inventory.
